diagnosis: DeepECG-CLIP-DINOv3: occlusion suspected (ACO probability 0.421, threshold 0.0506); complete (ACCO) more likely (ACCO probability 0.703); input: waveform | research use only, not a clinical diagnosis

heads.head: aco
heads.label: Acute coronary occlusion (ACO)
heads.description: Acute coronary occlusion (complete or incomplete) vs no occlusion on the catheterization that followed the ECG (ACS cohort v6). Fine-tuned DINOv3, top 2 blocks.

heads.head: acco_vs_aico
heads.label: Complete (ACCO) vs incomplete (AICO) occlusion
heads.description: Probability that an acute coronary occlusion is complete (ACCO) rather than incomplete (AICO). Trained on occlusion ECGs only; interpreted only when the aco output is positive.

input.description: DICOM 12-lead waveform, drawn with the training renderer

predictions.notes: Probabilities are model outputs, not calibrated risks. Each threshold is the Youden point of its validation set; an output without a threshold gives a probability only (positive is null). An output with applicableWhen is only interpreted when that output is positive.

modelRecommendations.en: Acute coronary occlusion suspected (probability 0.421). The model output is above the research threshold; complete occlusion (ACCO) more likely (probability 0.703). Correlate with symptoms, serial ECGs and troponin. Research use only: do not change management on the basis of this output.
modelRecommendations.fr: Occlusion coronarienne aiguë suspectée (probabilité 0.421). La sortie du modèle dépasse le seuil de recherche ; occlusion complète (ACCO) plus probable (probabilité 0.703). Corréler avec les symptômes, les ECG sériés et la troponine. Usage en recherche seulement : ne pas modifier la prise en charge sur la base de ce résultat.
